BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled on a picturesque elevated site in the heart of the stunning Slieve Bloom Mountains, this impressive six-bedroom detached residence offers an exceptional opportunity to acquire a spacious family home surrounded by natural beauty, peace, and tranquility. Extending to generous proportions throughout, this substantial property has been thoughtfully designed to accommodate modern family living, providing an abundance of living and bedroom space while enjoying breathtaking countryside surroundings. The residence is approached via a large tarmac driveway and is complemented by beautifully landscaped gardens that enhance the property's attractive setting. To the rear, a useful storage shed provides excellent additional storage and practical space for a variety of uses. This exceptional detached family home combines generous living accommodation, a beautiful elevated setting, and proximity to some of the Midlands' most spectacular natural scenery. Offering space, privacy, and an enviable lifestyle opportunity, it is perfectly suited to families seeking a high-quality home in a truly special location.

Idyllic Location
The property's setting is undoubtedly one of its most appealing attributes. Situated amidst the renowned beauty of the Slieve Bloom Mountains, residents can enjoy a lifestyle immersed in nature and outdoor recreation.
Just moments away lies the spectacular Glenbarrow Waterfall and Nature Reserve, one of the Midlands' most treasured natural attractions. The area boasts an extensive network of scenic walking trails, allowing residents to explore the unspoilt landscape, woodland paths, and cascading waterfalls that make this region so special.
Adding further appeal, Glenbarrow is home to a popular coffee shop and sauna facility, creating the perfect destination to relax and unwind while embracing the outdoors and the area's unique natural environment.

Despite its peaceful rural setting, the property enjoys excellent accessibility and convenience.
•	Approximately 4km from Clonaslee Village and all amenities including secondary school, Health Centre with GPs and Pharmacy
•	Easy access to local schools, shops, cafés, sporting facilities, and community amenities
•	Within comfortable commuting distance of Portlaoise, Tullamore and surrounding Midlands towns
